recovery.outbox_recovery.title: Outbox recovery
recovery.outbox_recovery.detail:
deploy.sh did not reconcile inflated-version STATE projection/cache for 9ea51073-e8c1-470c-a00c-40cddcff7333: expected version 6, got {'settlementId': '9ea51073-e8c1-470c-a00c-40cddcff7333', 'accountId': 'acct-2537', 'reference': 'CLR-367342', 'debitParty': 'CITIUS33', 'creditParty': 'CHASUS33', 'status': 'DISPUTED', 'clearingStage': 'CORRUPTED_INFLATED_STATE', 'version': 99, 'entryCount': 98, 'updatedAt': '2026-10-09T19:28:42.675796Z'}
assert 99 == 6
 +  where 99 = <built-in method get of dict object at 0x795eaa9f9ec0>('version')
 +    where <built-in method get of dict object at 0x795eaa9f9ec0> = {'accountId': 'acct-2537', 'clearingStage': 'CORRUPTED_INFLATED_STATE', 'creditParty': 'CHASUS33', 'debitParty': 'CITIUS33', ...}.get
